title: Queued follow-ups commit above the running turn's reply and keep 'queued' after delivery
observed: Transcript order after draining: you(start…), you(also check… · queued), you(and update… · queued), kiln(Working on the upload route now.), kiln(Checked the login route…). The first reply answers the first prompt but sits below the follow-ups; both follow-ups still read 'queued' after the model answered them.
expected: Queued prompts wait below the live turn (in the live region) and commit into the transcript when they are delivered, after the reply they followed; once delivered the 'queued' meta is gone.
design_ref: docs/kiln-design-handoff/README.md (Enter while busy becomes a queued follow-up)
